mapper.select: select from lab_report_template where del_flag='0' order by period_type,template_code,revision_no desc
select from lab_report_template where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
select from lab_report_template where id=#{id} and del_flag='0' for update
select from lab_report_template where period_type=#{periodType} and del_flag='0' order by id for update
select from lab_report_section where template_id=#{templateId} and del_flag='0' order by sort_no,id

select s.* from lab_report_section s join lab_report_template t on t.id=s.template_id and t.del_flag='0' where t.period_type=#{periodType} and t.default_flag='1' and t.latest_flag='1' and t.status='ENABLED' and s.section_type='MANUAL' and s.manual_flag='1' and s.visible_flag='1' and s.del_flag='0' order by s.sort_no,s.id
select revision_no from lab_report_template where template_code=#{templateCode} and del_flag='0' order by revision_no desc limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update lab_report_template set latest_flag='0',update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where template_code=#{templateCode} and latest_flag='1' and del_flag='0'
update lab_report_template set default_flag='0',update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where period_type=#{periodType} and id<>#{excludeId} and default_flag='1' and del_flag='0'

update lab_report_template set default_flag='1',update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and latest_flag='1' and status='ENABLED' and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select * from lab_report_summary where period=#{period} and biz_line=#{bizLine} and del_flag='0' order by section_code
select * from lab_report_summary where period=#{period} and biz_line=#{bizLine} and section_code=#{sectionCode} and del_flag='0' limit 1
select * from lab_report_summary where period=#{period} and biz_line=#{bizLine} and section_code=#{sectionCode} and del_flag='0' limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into lab_report_summary(period,biz_line,section_code,summary_json,summary_text,source_revision,del_flag,create_by,create_time,remark) values(#{period},#{bizLine},#{sectionCode},#{summaryJson},#{summaryText},1,'0',#{createBy},sysdate(),#{remark}) on duplicate key update id=last_insert_id(id),summary_json=values(summary_json),summary_text=values(summary_text),source_revision=source_revision+1,del_flag='0',update_by=values(create_by),update_time=sysdate(),remark=values(remark)
mapper.update: update lab_report_summary set del_flag='1',update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate() where period=#{period} and biz_line=#{bizLine} and section_code=#{sectionCode} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select distinct biz_line from lab_member where member_status='ACTIVE' and del_flag='0' and biz_line is not null and trim(biz_line)<>'' order by biz_line
select revision_no from lab_report_instance where template_code=#{templateCode} and period=#{period} and biz_line=#{bizLine} and del_flag='0' order by revision_no desc limit 1 for update

select s.id,s.period,s.revision_no revisionNo,s.period_version periodVersion, s.formal_revision_id formalRevisionId,s.performance_revision performanceRevision, s.closed_by closedBy,s.closed_time closedTime,s.calculation_version calculationVersion,s.del_flag delFlag from lab_period_close_snapshot s join lab_period_close p on p.period=s.period and p.period_version=s.period_version and p.close_status='CLOSED' and p.del_flag='0' where s.period=#{period} and s.del_flag='0' order by s.revision_no desc,s.id desc limit 1 for update

select p.member_id memberId,p.revision_no revisionNo from lab_perf_score p join lab_member m on m.id=p.member_id and m.del_flag='0' where p.period=#{period} and p.current_flag='1' and p.del_flag='0' and m.biz_line=#{bizLine} order by p.member_id
select from lab_report_instance where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
select from lab_report_instance where id=#{id} and del_flag='0' for update
select from lab_report_instance where template_code=#{templateCode} and period=#{period} and biz_line=#{bizLine} and del_flag='0' order by id for update
mapper.update: update lab_report_instance set lifecycle_status='SUPERSEDED',current_flag='0',update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where template_code=#{templateCode} and period=#{period} and biz_line=#{bizLine} and id<>#{excludeId} and lifecycle_status='FINALIZED' and current_flag='1' and del_flag='0'

update lab_report_instance set lifecycle_status='FINALIZED',current_flag='1',final_flag='1',update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and preview_only='0' and source_close_revision is not null and source_formal_revision is not null and source_execution_cutoff is not null and json_status='SUCCESS' and nullif(trim(json_path),'') is not null and markdown_status='SUCCESS' and nullif(trim(markdown_path),'') is not null and word_status='SUCCESS' and nullif(trim(word_path),'') is not null and pdf_status='SUCCESS' and nullif(trim(pdf_path),'') is not null and del_flag='0'

update lab_report_instance set lifecycle_status='FINALIZED',current_flag='1',final_flag='1',json_hash=#{jsonHash},markdown_hash=#{markdownHash},word_hash=#{wordHash},pdf_hash=#{pdfHash},update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and preview_only='0' and source_close_revision is not null and source_formal_revision is not null and source_execution_cutoff is not null and json_status='SUCCESS' and nullif(trim(json_path),'') is not null and markdown_status='SUCCESS' and nullif(trim(markdown_path),'') is not null and word_status='SUCCESS' and nullif(trim(word_path),'') is not null and pdf_status='SUCCESS' and nullif(trim(pdf_path),'') is not null and del_flag='0'

update lab_report_instance r join lab_report_job j on j.id=#{jobId} and j.report_id=r.id set r.json_status=if(r.json_status='SUCCESS' and nullif(trim(r.json_path),'') is not null,'SUCCESS','PENDING'),r.json_error=if(r.json_status='SUCCESS' and nullif(trim(r.json_path),'') is not null,r.json_error,null),r.markdown_status=if(r.markdown_status='SUCCESS' and nullif(trim(r.markdown_path),'') is not null,'SUCCESS','PENDING'),r.markdown_error=if(r.markdown_status='SUCCESS' and nullif(trim(r.markdown_path),'') is not null,r.markdown_error,null),r.update_by=#{actor},r.update_time=sysdate(),r.version=r.version+1 where r.id=#{id} and r.lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and (r.json_status in ('PENDING','FAILED') or (r.json_status='SUCCESS' and nullif(trim(r.json_path),'') is null) or r.markdown_status in ('PENDING','FAILED') or (r.markdown_status='SUCCESS' and nullif(trim(r.markdown_path),'') is null)) and r.json_status in ('PENDING','FAILED','SUCCESS') and r.markdown_status in ('PENDING','FAILED','SUCCESS') and r.del_flag='0' and j.job_status='RUNNING' and j.run_token=#{runToken}

update lab_report_instance r join lab_report_job j on j.id=#{jobId} and j.report_id=r.id set r.content_json=#{contentJson},r.json_status='SUCCESS',r.json_path=#{path},r.json_error=null,r.update_by=#{actor},r.update_time=sysdate(),r.version=r.version+1 where r.id=#{id} and r.lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and r.json_status='PENDING' and r.del_flag='0' and j.job_status='RUNNING' and j.run_token=#{runToken}

update lab_report_instance r join lab_report_job j on j.id=#{jobId} and j.report_id=r.id set r.content_markdown=#{contentMarkdown},r.markdown_status='SUCCESS',r.markdown_path=#{path},r.markdown_error=null,r.update_by=#{actor},r.update_time=sysdate(),r.version=r.version+1 where r.id=#{id} and r.lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and r.markdown_status='PENDING' and r.del_flag='0' and j.job_status='RUNNING' and j.run_token=#{runToken}

update lab_report_instance r join lab_report_job j on j.id=#{jobId} and j.report_id=r.id set r.json_status=case when r.json_status='SUCCESS' then r.json_status else 'FAILED' end,r.json_error=case when r.json_status='SUCCESS' then r.json_error else #{error} end,r.markdown_status=case when r.markdown_status='SUCCESS' then r.markdown_status else 'FAILED' end,r.markdown_error=case when r.markdown_status='SUCCESS' then r.markdown_error else #{error} end,r.update_by=#{actor},r.update_time=sysdate(),r.version=r.version+1 where r.id=#{id} and r.lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and (r.json_status<>'SUCCESS' or r.markdown_status<>'SUCCESS') and r.del_flag='0' and j.job_status='RUNNING' and j.run_token=#{runToken}

update lab_report_instance r join lab_report_job j on j.id=#{jobId} and j.report_id=r.id set r.word_status='PENDING',r.word_error=null,r.update_by=#{actor},r.update_time=sysdate(),r.version=r.version+1 where r.id=#{id} and r.lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and r.json_status='SUCCESS' and r.markdown_status='SUCCESS' and r.word_status in ('PENDING','FAILED') and r.del_flag='0' and j.job_status='RUNNING' and j.run_token=#{runToken}

update lab_report_instance r join lab_report_job j on j.id=#{jobId} and j.report_id=r.id set r.word_status='SUCCESS',r.word_path=#{path},r.word_error=null,r.update_by=#{actor},r.update_time=sysdate(),r.version=r.version+1 where r.id=#{id} and r.lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and r.word_status='PENDING' and r.del_flag='0' and j.job_status='RUNNING' and j.run_token=#{runToken}

update lab_report_instance r join lab_report_job j on j.id=#{jobId} and j.report_id=r.id set r.word_status='FAILED',r.word_error=#{error},r.update_by=#{actor},r.update_time=sysdate(),r.version=r.version+1 where r.id=#{id} and r.lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and r.word_status<>'SUCCESS' and r.del_flag='0' and j.job_status='RUNNING' and j.run_token=#{runToken}

update lab_report_instance r join lab_report_job j on j.id=#{jobId} and j.report_id=r.id set r.pdf_status='PENDING',r.pdf_error=null,r.update_by=#{actor},r.update_time=sysdate(),r.version=r.version+1 where r.id=#{id} and r.lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and r.word_status='SUCCESS' and r.pdf_status in ('PENDING','FAILED') and r.del_flag='0' and j.job_status='RUNNING' and j.run_token=#{runToken}

update lab_report_instance r join lab_report_job j on j.id=#{jobId} and j.report_id=r.id set r.pdf_status='SUCCESS',r.pdf_path=#{path},r.pdf_error=null,r.update_by=#{actor},r.update_time=sysdate(),r.version=r.version+1 where r.id=#{id} and r.lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and r.pdf_status='PENDING' and r.del_flag='0' and j.job_status='RUNNING' and j.run_token=#{runToken}

update lab_report_instance r join lab_report_job j on j.id=#{jobId} and j.report_id=r.id set r.pdf_status='FAILED',r.pdf_error=#{error},r.update_by=#{actor},r.update_time=sysdate(),r.version=r.version+1 where r.id=#{id} and r.lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and r.pdf_status<>'SUCCESS' and r.del_flag='0' and j.job_status='RUNNING' and j.run_token=#{runToken}

update lab_report_instance r join lab_report_job j on j.id=#{jobId} and j.report_id=r.id set r.word_status='PENDING',r.word_error=null,r.update_by=#{actor},r.update_time=sysdate(),r.version=r.version+1 where r.id=#{id} and r.lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and r.json_status='SUCCESS' and r.markdown_status='SUCCESS' and r.word_status in ('NOT_REQUESTED','PENDING') and r.del_flag='0' and j.job_type='DATA' and j.job_status='RUNNING' and j.run_token=#{runToken}

update lab_report_instance r join lab_report_job j on j.id=#{jobId} and j.report_id=r.id set r.pdf_status='PENDING',r.pdf_error=null,r.update_by=#{actor},r.update_time=sysdate(),r.version=r.version+1 where r.id=#{id} and r.lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and r.word_status='SUCCESS' and r.pdf_status in ('NOT_REQUESTED','PENDING') and r.del_flag='0' and j.job_type='WORD' and j.job_status='RUNNING' and j.run_token=#{runToken}
mapper.select: select from lab_report_job where report_id=#{reportId} and job_type=#{jobType} and job_status in ('QUEUED','RUNNING') and del_flag='0' order by id desc limit 1
select id from lab_report_instance where id=#{reportId} and lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and del_flag='0' for update
select from lab_report_job where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update lab_report_job set job_status='RUNNING',run_token=#{runToken},progress_rate=1,attempt_count=coalesce(attempt_count,0)+1,started_time=#{startedTime},finished_time=null,error_message=null,update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and job_status='QUEUED' and run_token is null and del_flag='0'
update lab_report_job set update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and job_status='RUNNING' and run_token=#{runToken} and del_flag='0'

update lab_report_job set job_status='SUCCESS',progress_rate=100,finished_time=#{finishedTime},error_message=null,update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and job_status='RUNNING' and run_token=#{runToken} and del_flag='0'

update lab_report_job set job_status='FAILED',finished_time=#{finishedTime},error_message=#{error},update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and job_status='RUNNING' and run_token=#{runToken} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select from lab_report_job where report_id=#{reportId} and del_flag='0' order by id

select from lab_report_job j where j.id>#{afterId} and j.del_flag='0' and exists(select 1 from lab_report_instance r where r.id=j.report_id and r.lifecycle_status='DRAFT' and r.del_flag='0') and (j.job_status='QUEUED' or (j.job_status='RUNNING' and coalesce(j.update_time,j.started_time,j.create_time)<=#{staleBefore})) order by j.id limit #{pageSize}
mapper.update: update lab_report_job j left join lab_report_instance r on r.id=j.report_id and r.del_flag='0' set j.job_status='FAILED',j.run_token=null,j.finished_time=sysdate(),j.error_message='REPORT_JOB_ORPHANED: The mutable report no longer exists.',j.update_by=#{actor},j.update_time=sysdate(),j.version=j.version+1 where j.del_flag='0' and j.job_status in ('QUEUED','RUNNING') and (r.id is null or coalesce(r.lifecycle_status,'')<>'DRAFT')

update lab_report_job set job_status='QUEUED',run_token=null,progress_rate=0,started_time=null,finished_time=null,error_message='Recovered after an interrupted worker',update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and job_status='RUNNING' and run_token=#{runToken} and coalesce(update_time,started_time,create_time)<=#{staleBefore} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from lab_report_job where report_id=#{reportId} and job_status in ('QUEUED','RUNNING') and del_flag='0'
select count(1) from lab_report_job where report_id=#{reportId} and job_status in ('SUCCESS','FAILED') and del_flag='0'

select artifact_path from (select json_path artifact_path from lab_report_instance where del_flag='0' and json_path is not null union all select markdown_path from lab_report_instance where del_flag='0' and markdown_path is not null union all select word_path from lab_report_instance where del_flag='0' and word_path is not null union all select pdf_path from lab_report_instance where del_flag='0' and pdf_path is not null) paths where nullif(trim(artifact_path),'') is not null
